direction.name: 빛의 크롭과 컬러 사진 몽타주
direction.concept: An original photographic montage built from complete accurate lamp and large cropped illuminated folded-paper surfaces. The light/paper folds organise the whole composition and create scale/colour tension; not a blank room/wall for title panels.
direction.image_grammar: Strong oblique photo crop boundaries, warm-light/forest-green colour tension, visible folded-paper depth and a precise complete lamp across an intersecting crop. Only justified crops of this product/light theme, no chrome/blobs/toy effects.
direction.body_flow: A folded-paper light edge carries the first view into the two contiguous description sentences. The main title relates to the intersecting crop as a second anchor. Event/date/place and visit/invitation/URL join the description reading plane through clear shared edge/spacing, each function remains a coherent block. Keep the paragraph readable horizontally rather than lettering around a curved form.
direction.type: Distinctive restrained humanist Korean/Latin sans body, balanced apertures and moderate width, stable baseline and carefully paced multiline paragraph. Stronger italic/oblique title treatment may be used only if Korean letterforms stay coherent; body remains stable.
direction.distinctness: Oblique photo crops and illuminated-paper scale tension actively construct space, unlike the calm editorial sequence, drafted plan or painted still life.

common_constraints: Prioritize the new skill first-generation body-copy design. Print copy once in a compact positive tool brief, no rubric or whole plan dump.
User product identity and literal copy are authoritative; case-specific direction is implementation guidance, not invented user-fixed coordinates/font/grid.
Every role views its own actual study originals before designing. Study material is not a client asset and is not automatically passed to native generation.
The Canva whole sample is a negative default-template example: take grouping/proximity only, do not repeat its title/date/panel scaffold.
Never read peer makers or quality feedback. Select/close own result before independent evaluation.

assets.kind: synthetic product photograph-style fixture, not real client photograph or a poster

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
